title: Pitter Patter | KEY.co
description_expanded: This comfortable beach home is conveniently located near Town Center and the water, providing the perfect blend of privacy and proximity. Nestled among tall trees, it offers a tranquil retreat while being just a stone's throw away from all the attractions in Seaside. Step onto the large front porch and relax in rocking chairs, basking in the gentle sea breeze. The enclosed space is a haven for families with children, offering a safe and enjoyable environment. The first floor also features a spacious king-sized master bedroom with a spa-inspired master bath, ensuring a luxurious and rejuvenating experience. Upstairs, two more bedrooms await. The queen-sized bedroom offers a tranquil window seat, providing the perfect spot to curl up with a good book or savor your morning coffee. The second bedroom is ideal for the kids, with dual bunk beds and a nearby full bath. All of our properties have internet access. However, we do not and cannot guarantee internet connection or access due to service being provided by an outside third-party vendor, restrictions placed on internet services by personal computers, different connection specifications, and any additional factors that may lead to interruption, failure, or unavailability of internet service. No refunds will be given.
